senses.gloss: (= אתנסיס, אתנסס, v. נסס; or Ithpe. of נוס or ניס) to be taken sick.
units: Sabb. 145ᵇ אִיתְנַסִּי (Ms. M. אִיתְנַיֵּיס אִיתְנַיְּיסִי Ithpa.) I should have grown sick; (Ms. Oxf. איסתכני I should have been in danger).

<cite ref="Gittin 56a">Git. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אִתְנִיסָא</he> (or <he>אִתְנַיְּסָה</he>) she grew sick (from aversion), fainted. Cmp. <cite ref="A01525"><he>אִיסְתְּנִיס</he></cite>. [<cite ref="A01657"><he>אִיתְנִיס</he></cite> = <cite ref="A02260"><he>אִתְאֲנִיס</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A02260"><he>אֲנַס</he></cite>.]
